title: Quest for the Crystal
moral: Working together with courage can overcome darkness.

story: Oliver and his friends set out to find the Crystal of Light to save their kingdom from darkness. They walked through a dark forest filled with strange creatures. A storm made things harder, but Oliver used the stars to guide them. They finally found the glowing crystal and used its light to remove the darkness. The kingdom was saved, and they became heroes, proud of their courage and teamwork.
